wages.text: Kozycki says he supports raising the federal minimum wage and indexing it to inflation; at a debate, he also answered yes to a $15 minimum wage.
wages.quote: Tony supports raising the minimum wage and indexing it so workers do not keep losing ground every year Congress fails to act.

trade.text: At a debate, Kozycki answered no when asked whether he supported the administration’s tariff policies.
trade.quote: Do you support the current administration's tariff policies? Kozycki: no

debt.text: Kozycki says he would oppose Social Security benefit cuts and supports protecting Medicare.
debt.quote: Tony will oppose attempts to cut or privatize Social Security benefits, raise the retirement age, or means-test benefits.

housing.text: Kozycki says he would support federal grants and investment to build affordable housing.
housing.quote: Tony will fight for federal housing grants and direct investment in affordable housing construction across Georgia, with an emphasis on communities that have been priced out of their own neighborhoods.

guns.text: At a debate, Kozycki answered yes to universal background checks, a federal assault weapons ban, and red flag laws.
guns.quote: Universal background checks for gun purchases? Kozycki: yes Long: yes Norton: yes Toweh: yes

health.text: At a debate, Kozycki answered yes to Medicare for All and Medicaid expansion in Georgia.
health.quote: Medicare for all? Kozycki: yes Long: yes Norton: yes Toweh: yes

energy.text: At a debate, Kozycki said climate change is a national security threat, supported rejoining the Paris Climate Agreement, and opposed natural gas development on federal lands.
energy.quote: Supportive of rejoining the Paris Climate Agreement? Kozycki: yes Long: yes Norton: yes Toweh: yes

voting.text: At a debate, Kozycki answered yes to making Election Day a federal holiday.
voting.quote: Make election day a federal holiday? Kozycki: yes Long: yes Norton: yes Toweh: yes

tax.text: His campaign says he supports lowering taxes and cutting inflationary spending.
tax.quote: Cut inflationary spending, lower taxes, unleash American energy, and reduce the pressure families feel every day.

debt.text: His campaign says he is fighting deficits and debt that raise costs for families.
debt.quote: Rich is fighting inflationary spending, deficits, and debt that make everyday life more expensive for working families.

immigration.text: He supports building a border wall, enforcing immigration laws, and targeting drug cartels.
immigration.quote: To secure our nation and to save countless lives, we must finally build a wall on our southern border, enforce our laws, and crush the cartels who prey upon human misery.

abortion.text: He says life begins at conception and has cosponsored legislation declaring a right to life for the unborn.
abortion.quote: Life begins at conception, and I am committed to defending and supporting the unborn, recognizing their inherent dignity and fundamental human rights.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which would bar federally funded schools from allowing biological males in women’s and girls’ sports.
gender.quote: schools receiving federal funding cannot allow biological men to participate in athletic programs or activities that are designed for women and girls.

energy.text: His campaign calls for unleashing American energy as part of reducing household cost pressures.
energy.quote: Cut inflationary spending, lower taxes, unleash American energy, and reduce the pressure families feel every day.

voting.text: A local news report says he sponsored the SAVE Act, which requires a voter’s name on their birth certificate to match their driver’s license.
voting.quote: A constituent questioned McCormick’s support of the SAVE Act, which requires a voter’s name on their birth certificate to match their driver’s license.
